20 min to 2 h per task; the server takes weeks to unlock all the stages

An island full of nightmare creatures was discovered by the Inquisition. This quest is a set of tasks in Roshamuul that advance a **permanent world change** of the server: first the bridge of Lower Roshamuul is rebuilt, then the wall of Guzzlemaw Valley is torn down and finally {creature:Gaz'haragoth} is killed in Upper Roshamuul. Along the way you earn Inquisition Gold, {item:Essence of Dread|Essences of Dread}, {item:Cluster of Solace|Clusters of Solace} and {item:Essence of Wishful Thinking|Essences of Wishful Thinking}, which are used to craft and upgrade {wiki:Umbral Items|Umbral Items}.
Nightmare creatures lurk on an island recently discovered by the Inquisition...
No minimum level, but the **recommended level is 200+**: all the creatures on the island are very strong.
The {wiki:Guzzlemaw Valley} tasks are only possible after the server reaches **stage 2**, and the {wiki:Upper Roshamuul} ones only at **stage 3** (see section 1).
{spell:Levitate} spell to reach one of the bottles for The First Mate mission.
at least 2 empty ones + 1 with water for each Mortar; bring more to make several at once
to fish up the Messages in a Bottle (The First Mate)
to dig the final tile of The First Mate mission
loot from Silencers; ≈20 are enough for the Luring Silencers mission
plenty, to trap Terrorsleeps and Feversleeps in the Waters of Life mission
several, for the Mend What's Broken mission (loot from Retching Horrors or buy from players)
Lots of potions and supplies: every zone is dangerous
210 gp for the trip there (Thais → Roshamuul) and another 210 gp for the way back
**Inquisition Gold** from the Lower Roshamuul and Guzzlemaw Valley tasks (manage it with {npc:Sandomo}: {key:gratitude} → {key:repairs})
Server-wide access to {wiki:Guzzlemaw Valley} and {wiki:Upper Roshamuul} and the ability to create or upgrade {wiki:Umbral Items|Umbral Items}
Server **Stage 2**: when the Lower Roshamuul bridge is repaired (Mortar handed in and monsters killed in Lower Roshamuul).
Permanent world change for the whole server; it only changes at Server Save.
Upper Roshamuul (with Roshamuul Prison, Roshamuul Mines and Roshamuul Cistern)
Server **Stage 3**: when the wall in the north of Guzzlemaw Valley is torn down through the valley's tasks.
Permanent world change for the whole server; Roshamuul citizens can go directly to the Upper Roshamuul temple.
NPCs of the city of Upper Roshamuul
Server **Stage 4**: after {creature:Gaz'haragoth} is killed at the top of the central mountain of Upper Roshamuul.
Opens when the server completes the task *Soothing Bad Dreams* 20 times.
Temporary world change with no warning; it is rarely open.
With the {item:Essence of Dread|Essences of Dread}, {item:Cluster of Solace|Clusters of Solace} and {item:Essence of Wishful Thinking|Essences of Wishful Thinking} earned in the tasks.
By doing the missions *A Cup of Tea*, *Ancient Dreams* and *Waters of Life* (from {npc:Morax}) and *Mend What's Broken* (from {npc:Dream Butterfly}).
You don't need to request the "find things on the ground" tasks: you are automatically put on the mission when you interact with the objects.
At Dream Butterfly you can accept **all** the tasks at once — that is the recommended way.
Kills made before you request a kill task count all the same; requesting the task just gives you the counter in the Quest Log.
Server stages only change at {wiki:Server Save}. On low-population servers it can take weeks.
Keep any leftover Dream Sand and the {item:Strange Good Night Songs}: on the Soothing Bad Dreams repeat you save half the work.
1. Getting to Roshamuul and understanding the stages
This quest is a permanent world change with 4 stages. Each player contributes with tasks; when the server does enough, it unlocks the next zone at the next Server Save.

Travel to **Roshamuul** from **Thais**: at the harbour, say {key:hi}, {key:roshamuul}, {key:yes} to {npc:Captain Bluebear} (210 gp). The boat docks at Lower Roshamuul. Your base is the human camp in the south, in **Lower Roshamuul**, where {npc:Captain Chelop} (by the coast) and {npc:Sandomo} are.
To get back to Thais, see the last section ("Leaving Roshamuul").
Check which stage your server is on and which tasks move it on to the next one:
How to move on to the next one
Rebuild the bridge: deliver Mortar and kill monsters in Lower Roshamuul (sections 2 and 3)
Break down the wall in the north of Guzzlemaw Valley: blow horns, desecrate shrines, lure Silencers and kill Sights of Surrender (sections 4 to 7)
Kill {creature:Gaz'haragoth}, who appears at the top of the central mountain of Upper Roshamuul
The whole island + the NPCs of the city of Upper Roshamuul

Estimate from servers that have already passed stage 1: ≈30,000 {creature:Frazzlemaw|Frazzlemaws} (76%) and ≈9,500 {creature:Silencer|Silencers} (24%) killed, and between 100,000 and 150,000 Inquisition Gold earned on the server. Expect at least one week in stage 1 and one month in stage 2.
Check the Inquisition Gold with Sandomo
Every task in Lower Roshamuul and Guzzlemaw Valley gives **Inquisition Gold**. To manage the rewards, talk to {npc:Sandomo} at the camp: {key:hi}, {key:gratitude} and then {key:repairs}.

Besides the permanent stages, there are temporary world changes: if the server does many tasks in Guzzlemaw Valley, {creature:Sight of Surrender|Sights of Surrender} appear in that area over the following days. If it does many in Upper Roshamuul (20 Soothing Bad Dreams tasks), the {wiki:Dark Grounds} open up, north of the depot, with a small spawn of Sights of Surrender.

From the camp, go up the ramp to reach the hunting area of {wiki:Lower Roshamuul} (between the camp and the bridge; it stretches west and east from the ramps). Kill the local creatures of Lower Roshamuul. Every {creature:Silencer} and every {creature:Frazzlemaw} is worth **1 Inquisition Gold** and helps rebuild the bridge.
Dangerous area: level 200 recommended. To get back to the camp (and the boat), go down the same ramp.

Every {item:Bucket Full of Mortar} delivered at the bridge is worth **100 Inquisition Gold**. You need at least 2 empty buckets and 1 bucket of water per delivery; you can do several at once if you carry more buckets.
Fill a {item:Bucket} with {item:Water (Liquid)|water} at a {wiki:Small Brook|Small Brook} or at any point on the coast by the camp.

Use the {item:Pick} on the gravel stones on the mountain and on the south-east coast. There is a ≈50% chance of success:
- **Success** (*"Crushing the stone produces some fine gravel."*): {item:Fine Gravel} appears on the ground — **use it** to add to your count.
- **Failure** (*"Crushing the stone yields nothing but slightly finer, yet still unusable rubble."*): a {creature:Frazzlemaw} spawns.
Either way, the stone disappears and comes back after 1 minute.
Every failure spawns a {creature:Frazzlemaw}. Wiki statistic: 101 successes in 217 attempts.
There are more gravel stones one floor up (floor 6), on the mountain. Repeat until you have **10 successes**: only then does the bucket become a {item:Bucket Filled with Gravel}.
Until you complete the 10, the bucket stays a normal {item:Bucket} and the count is saved on your character — buckets cannot be shared between players.

Go down any of the ramps in the south-east area. You appear in a **random** cave (not necessarily the one below the ramp). Leave and enter caves until you find one with {item:Chalk} on the ground. **Use** the chalk on the ground to add to your count. After you have used **10 different chalk spots** you receive a {item:Bucket Filled with Chalk}. To leave a cave, use one of its ramps: you do not always come out where you went in, so check where you are before carrying on.
Number of chalk deposits (Chalk) per cave
Spots used recently do not count; the chalk reappears after 2 minutes. The destination of each ramp changes every 2 minutes: if you keep going in circles, go to another ramp or wait 2 minutes.
Sometimes you appear in a lava cave with active {creature:Lavahole|Lava Holes} that attack you. Run to the **left (west)** side and step into the {item:Instable Vortex} to escape.
Use the bucket of gravel on the bucket of chalk to get {item:Gravel and Chalk in a Bucket}. Then use it with the bucket of water to get a {item:Bucket Full of Mortar}.

Go up to the bridge at the top of the mountain (two floors above the camp). Next to {npc:Mortis} are the {item:Trough for Mortar|Troughs for Mortar}: use the {item:Bucket Full of Mortar} on one of them.
100 Inquisition Gold per bucket of Mortar
4. The Walls of Roshamuul — Blowing Horns (stage 2)
Worth **100 Inquisition Gold**. You can repeat it once a day (you can only take the mouthpiece once a day).
At the human camp in the south, open the {item:Box} to take a {item:Mouthpiece for a Horn}. You can take one per day.

Go to {wiki:Guzzlemaw Valley}: from the camp, go up the ramp to Lower Roshamuul and cross the bridge to the **north** (it is only repaired from stage 2). Head for the far **east** of the valley. Along the mountains there are heaps of bones; the one you are looking for is called {item:Large Pile of Various Bones} (*"Several large and curved bones are protruding from this pile."*).
At least one of the piles is under a stone that cannot be moved (unusable), and some are in the lair of the {creature:Mawhawk}, which is rarely accessible.
To get back to the camp, cross the bridge south again and go down the ramp. Guzzlemaw Valley is very dangerous (level 250+ recommended for knights and mages).

Use the pile of bones:
- **Success** (*"Amidst the pile of various bones you find a large, hollow part, similar to a pipe."*): you receive a {item:Crude Horn of Bone}.
- **Failure** (*"You ransack the pile but fail to find any useful parts."*): a {creature:Guzzlemaw} spawns.
Either way, the pile becomes unusable for 2 minutes.
Success: you get the Crude Horn of Bone

Use the {item:Mouthpiece for a Horn} on the {item:Crude Horn of Bone} to get a {item:Crude Horn with Mouthpiece}. Take it to the wall that leads to {wiki:Upper Roshamuul} (north of Guzzlemaw Valley) and use the horn on any part of the wall.
5. The Walls of Roshamuul — Desecrating Shrines (stage 2)
Worth **10 Inquisition Gold** and you can repeat it every 10 minutes.
In {wiki:Guzzlemaw Valley}, look for {item:Silencer Excretion} on the ground, near the {creature:Silencer|Silencers}. Pick it up.

Find a Maw Shrine (a {item:Skull (Item)|skull} held up by {item:Branch (Bamboo)|bamboo branches}) and use the {item:Silencer Excretion} on the **skull** part. A {creature:Guzzlemaw} spawns near the shrine.
Using the Silencer Excretion on the skull of the Maw Shrine
6. The Walls of Roshamuul — Luring Silencers (stage 2)
Kill {creature:Silencer|Silencers} until you have lots of {item:Silencer Resonating Chamber|Silencer Resonating Chambers} (about 20 should be enough).

Go to the {wiki:Silencer Plateau} (floor 5), in the south-east of Roshamuul: go up **twice** from the marked spot and use the {item:Silencer Resonating Chamber|Resonating Chambers}. Some break with no effect; when one works you get an orange message similar to a Silencer's. Every Chamber used successfully gives **50 Inquisition Gold**.
Orange success message when using the Resonating Chamber
50 Inquisition Gold per successful Chamber; achievement **Luring Silence** after 5
To leave the plateau, go back down the same way (two floors) to Guzzlemaw Valley.

When **5 Chambers have been used successfully**, a Silencer raid starts on the Plateau: 4 waves of {creature:Silencer|Silencers}, ending with 3–5 {creature:Sight of Surrender|Sights of Surrender}. From the start of the raid, Chambers cannot be used on the Plateau for about 30 minutes.
Careful: dozens of creatures appear during the raid

Because of a bug, one Silencer or Sight of Surrender from each wave may spawn on the floor below (on the stairs). If you wait downstairs with the team without killing the creatures, they do not disappear, and whoever goes up the ramp to use the Chambers takes damage for a few seconds.
10 Inquisition Gold per kill; achievement **Never Surrender** for taking part in the death of 100
8. Upper Roshamuul — asking the Dream Butterfly for tasks (stage 3)

From stage 3, cross Guzzlemaw Valley to the **north-east** and go through the open wall into {wiki:Upper Roshamuul}. West of the wall is the entrance to the {wiki:Roshamuul Prison}; the **depot** and the **temple** are north-west of the wall. If you are a citizen of Roshamuul, you can go straight to the Upper Roshamuul temple (west of the depot), which saves you crossing the valley.
Upper Roshamuul is very dangerous: level 250+ recommended.

Go to the {npc:Dream Butterfly}, on the **east** side of Upper Roshamuul (floor 6). Say {key:hi} and {key:help} to see the tasks: {key:soothe}, {key:mend}, {key:horrors} and {key:fears}. Accept them all at once.
Ask the {npc:Dream Butterfly} for the task ({key:horrors}) and kill **100** {creature:Retching Horror|Retching Horrors}, which roam all over the surface of Upper Roshamuul.
Go back to the {npc:Dream Butterfly}: {key:hi}, {key:horrors}, {key:yes}. You can repeat it 3 hours after handing in.
Ask for the task ({key:fears}) and kill **500** {creature:Choking Fear|Choking Fears} on the surface of Upper Roshamuul.
Go back to the {npc:Dream Butterfly}: {key:hi}, {key:fears}, {key:yes}. You can repeat it 3 hours after handing in.
Ask the {npc:Dream Butterfly} for the task with {key:mend}.

You need several {item:Broken Dream|Broken Dreams}. The easiest way is the loot from {creature:Retching Horror|Retching Horrors} (no NPC buys them, so other players sell them cheap). Alternatively, use the magical objects of Upper Roshamuul (some glow until they are used); each one takes 5 minutes to recover and the chance is low.
Objects that can give a Broken Dream
Finding a Broken Dream in a magical object

Possible results when using the objects: nothing (*"Nothing happens."*), {item:Broken Dream} (*"You found a broken dream."*) or junk ({item:Piece of Iron}, {item:Old Twig}, {item:Some Leaves}, {item:Crystal Rubbish}, {item:Rubbish}).
Using the Broken Dreams on the Half-Buried Faces

The **south-east** face is relatively safe: use the ramp to the east as an escape zone and kill the creatures near it. After that you only have to deal with a {creature:Silencer} that spawns nearby, because the other spawns can be blocked.
After you have freed **3** Shimmying Butterflies, go back to the {npc:Dream Butterfly} and say {key:mend}. You cannot free more than 3 per task.
Follow the coast **south-east** of the Dream Butterfly and use the {item:Stony Pond}. Collect the reward and go back up the stairs.
The Stony Pond southeast of the Dream Butterfly
Reward for the Mend What's Broken mission
2 {item:Essence of Wishful Thinking}. Repeatable 2 hours later; achievement **Dream Wright** for freeing 100 Shimmying Butterflies (34 tasks)
Talk to the {npc:Dream Butterfly}: {key:hi}, {key:help}, {key:soothe}, {key:yes}. You receive a {item:Delicate Pan}.
While you are here, go down a little to the south and pick up the {item:Bowl of Tea Leaves} for the A Cup of Tea mission (section 14).

Now you have to find the 3 special {item:Sneeze Blossom (Song)|Sneeze Blossoms} to learn the song (the normal Sneeze Blossoms, like the ones near the Dream Butterfly, will not do). Start with the one on the **coast**, next to the river. Use it; it points you to the aqueduct.
Go to the Sneeze Blossom at the **aqueduct** (floor 6) and use it. It points you to the waterfall.
Go to the Sneeze Blossom by the **waterfall** and use it. Then **use it again** to learn the song: you receive the {item:Strange Good Night Songs}.
Sneeze Blossom next to the waterfall
The recommended order is coast → aqueduct → waterfall, but you do not have to follow the hints from the flowers.

**Equip** the {item:Strange Good Night Songs} (in the shield slot) and look for {item:Bad Dream|Bad Dreams} on the **east** side of Upper Roshamuul. Use the {item:Dream Sand} on each one: you get *"<humming a disturbing grating tune> - The dream settles down a little."* and the Bad Dream disappears. Repeat until you have calmed **5**.
Using Dream Sand on a Bad Dream with the song equipped

Go back to the {npc:Dream Butterfly}; he sends you to the {wiki:Junkyard Tar Lake} room. There, find the ladder surrounded by tar, step on the ladder and open the bookcase to receive the reward. You can repeat the task 3 hours later.
Ladder surrounded by tar (Junkyard Tar Lake)
Bookcase with the reward in the Junkyard Tar Lake
Do not stay too long at the bookcase, or you get kicked out.

To repeat (for example, to open the {wiki:Dark Grounds}): keep all the Dream Sand you collect and the {item:Strange Good Night Songs} in your backpack. You do not need to go back to the river or the Sneeze Blossoms: just ask for the task, use 5 Dream Sand on 5 Bad Dreams and report back.
Talk to {npc:Morax} and ask about {key:ancient dreams}.
Taking the Dream Nebuliser from the box
Go to the {wiki:Roshamuul Mines}, on the **east** side of Upper Roshamuul, and open the box at the entrance to get a {item:Dream Nebuliser}. You can take a new one every 3 hours.
Open the box at the mine entrance to get the Dream Nebuliser
All over the mine there are {item:Fog Lantern|Fog Lanterns} on the walls and {item:Traces of an Ancient Dream} on the rocks. Use a Fog Lantern first: for **10 seconds** you can extract dreams.
Fog Lantern (right) and Traces of an Ancient Dream (left)
Extracting Ancient Dreams from the rocks with the Dream Nebuliser
You need **3** Ancient Dreams per task. The Nebuliser lasts for up to 9 extractions before it breaks.
When you have the 3 Ancient Dreams, go back the same way to the mine entrance, on the east side of Upper Roshamuul, and go to {npc:Morax} (north of the central mountain).
Take the 3 {item:Ancient Dream|Ancient Dreams} to {npc:Morax}: he swaps them for an essence. You can repeat it 3 hours later.
All over Upper Roshamuul there are many {item:Pottery Pieces}; some are quest objects. There are 3 pots for each item, but you only need **one of each**.
Use one of the marked {item:Pottery Pieces} pots to get a {item:Bowl of Tea Leaves}.
Use one of the marked pots to get a {item:Tea Spoon}.
Use one of the marked pots (all underground) to get a {item:Tea Cup}.

Use the {item:Bowl of Tea Leaves} on the {item:Tea Cup} to get a {item:Filled Cup}. Go to the {wiki:Dream Sand River} and use the {item:Filled Cup} on the water. Then use the {item:Tea Spoon} on the {item:Filled Cup}.

Go to Morax's bed (one floor up) and **use** the pillow. You appear inside his dream. According to Morax's wiki page, you only enter the dream if you have an {item:Essence of Dread} or an {item:Essence of Wishful Thinking} in your backpack.
In the dream, go down and find {npc:Morax}. Say {key:hi} and {key:parched} to give him the tea. The mission is complete.
The wiki does not describe a separate exit from the dream: go back the same way (go up where you came down).
Kill **100** {creature:Terrorsleep|Terrorsleeps} in the {wiki:Roshamuul Mines} and the {wiki:Roshamuul Cistern}. {creature:Feversleep|Feversleeps} do **not** count.

The cistern works like the maze of the {wiki:Pits of Inferno Quest}. Bring plenty of supplies and lots of {item:Energy Wall Rune|Energy Wall Runes} to trap the {creature:Terrorsleep|Terrorsleeps} and {creature:Feversleep|Feversleeps}.
Talk to {npc:Morax}, ask about the {key:waters} and offer to help ({key:yes}). You receive a {item:Pendulum}.

Go to the {wiki:Roshamuul Cistern}, in the north-east of Upper Roshamuul. Make your way to the {item:Water Wheel|Water Wheels}, using the {item:Pendulum} to clear the {item:Poison Spine|Poison Spines} from the path. Pull the **3** levers. The cistern stairs do not work like normal stairs: each one always takes you to the same fixed destination, which is not necessarily the floor next to it. Use the cistern maps.
Only those who have pulled the **3 levers** can enter the Shiversleeps chamber: every player on the team has to pull them. After being pulled, each lever takes ≈2 minutes to be usable again.
Go to the **east** side of the "safe zone" (floor 11) and step on the **north-east** ramp. You enter a chamber with 3 {creature:Shiversleep|Shiversleeps}.
Only one person at a time can enter the Shiversleeps room.

Use the {item:Pendulum} on each {creature:Shiversleep} to hypnotise it: it turns into a {creature:Shimmying Butterfly}. After all 3, step into the {item:Instable Vortex} on the **west** side of the chamber.
Instable Vortex on the west side of the chamber
You appear in a reward room. Open the {item:Pile of Bones (Quest)} on the **north-west** side. When you want to leave, step on the stairs: you come out outside the cistern.
Reward room with the Pile of Bones

On the way out you may appear in the middle of a horde of {creature:Retching Horror|Retching Horrors} and {creature:Choking Fear|Choking Fears}. If you take too long in the Shiversleeps room or in the reward room, you get kicked out to the safe zone. In a team, it is best for everyone to collect the reward and wait to be kicked out, so you do not face the monsters outside alone.
Go back to {npc:Morax} and tell him about the mission of the {key:waters}. He tells you to keep the essence.

In Lower Roshamuul and Guzzlemaw Valley there are 11 {item:Message in a Bottle|Messages in a Bottle} along the coast. At every server save, one bottle appears floating in its spot and can be fished up.

At each location, use the {item:Fishing Rod} on the bottle (*"You cast your fishing rod to see if you can catch the bottle."*). If you fail, no further message appears: try again, with no limit. When you succeed, you read a word (*"You find a letter inside the bottle. It says: ..."*). The bottle stays there for other players. For the bottle west of the mountain you have to go down with {spell:Levitate} (and go back up with Levitate).
Location (clockwise from the south of the camp)
West of the mountain (you have to go down with {spell:Levitate})
you — west of the mountain (go down with Levitate)

Only one of the 11 bottles appears at each server save, so this mission takes several days. When you fish up the last one you get: *"You have found all messages in this puzzle, now you can piece together all the clues."*
"Three" is capitalised (first word) and "dig." has a full stop (last word). The sentence is: ***"Three stones bedded in green will show you where to dig."***

After you have fished up all the messages, go to the **east** part of {wiki:Guzzlemaw Valley} and look for 3 stones on mossy ground. Use the {item:Shovel} on the tile between the 3 stones: you are teleported to a room with a skeleton to the east.
Area of the 3 stones (centre of the wiki map, approximate)

Use the skeleton. You receive 2 papers written by Han, former First Mate of the S.S. Primordia, which tell how Captain Marv repaired a cursed ring on the island and was consumed by it, and warn that *there are other rings*.
The wiki does not describe the exit from this room: look for the passage you came in by or go back to Guzzlemaw Valley the same way.

Go back to the Inquisition camp, in the south-west of the island (go down the Lower Roshamuul ramp; from Guzzlemaw Valley or Upper Roshamuul, first cross the bridge to the south). Talk to {npc:Captain Chelop}, next to the boat: {key:hi}, {key:sail}, {key:thais}, {key:yes} (210 gp). Thais is the only destination.
The First Mate mission has no known continuation.
The Upper Roshamuul tasks repeat: Ancient Dreams, A Retched Beginning, Face Your Fears and Soothing Bad Dreams every 3 hours; Mend What's Broken every 2 hours.
There is no practical way to know how many tasks are left before the server changes stage; the change only happens at server save.
